nodes.label: Vertical Slices
nodes.rationale: Work is organized into small end-to-end slices so requirements, implementation, validation, and evidence remain connected.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Completion
nodes.rationale: A passing build is only one part of completion evidence; required evidence scales with risk.

nodes.label: TypeScript Monorepo
nodes.rationale: The intended architecture separates web, API, and shared package boundaries.

nodes.label: Behavioral Coverage
nodes.rationale: Testing should provide meaningful confidence in behavior rather than optimize arbitrary coverage percentages.

nodes.label: Cloud-Agnostic Deployment
nodes.rationale: Hosting and operational choices remain undecided during the foundation phase to preserve flexibility.

nodes.label: Threat Modeling
nodes.rationale: Security concerns are reviewed as part of each feature, with higher-risk changes requiring explicit approval and threat modeling.

nodes.label: Boundary Contracts
nodes.rationale: APIs are security and compatibility boundaries, so input and output contracts and authorization must be explicit.

nodes.label: Normalized Ownership Models
nodes.rationale: Normalized ownership models are preferred until measured read requirements justify denormalization.
